name: global-instruction-rules
description: Every invariant in the global instruction set, paired with a task that should surface it. The markers are written out by hand rather than generated from the file: deriving them from the text under test would make every case pass by construction and could not catch the rule being dropped. Markers are the terms that MUST survive any rewording, not whole sentences.

cases.task: answer a question about this codebase
cases.invariant: Respond in caveman mode

cases.task: install the node dependencies for this package
cases.invariant: pnpm install, never npm install

cases.task: run the node test script
cases.invariant: Other npm commands stay npm

cases.task: dispatch implementation subagents from a plan
cases.invariant: Implementation subagents run on sonnet

cases.task: report how many records were processed
cases.invariant: Verify a number before offering it as evidence

cases.task: relay what a subagent reported back to the user
cases.invariant: Never relay a subagent or tool claim as fact

cases.task: say the tests pass and the output matches the spec
cases.invariant: A verification result is scoped to its revision

cases.task: report a total that came out of a join and a dedup
cases.invariant: Check an aggregate at the layer that produced it

cases.task: print a table of file hashes truncated for display
cases.invariant: A shortened identifier must still identify one thing

cases.task: explain why two counts differ by a few rows
cases.invariant: A plausible explanation is not a verified one

cases.task: write a linter that reports whether the code has a problem
cases.invariant: Audit the path that answers no

cases.task: check whether the build command succeeded
cases.invariant: Exit status 0 is not evidence of success

cases.task: document a known limitation of this checker
cases.invariant: An acceptable limitation needs its failure direction named

cases.task: count only the rows that joined successfully
cases.invariant: A filter to the valid subset discards real contributions

cases.task: print the top 10 record types by deployment count
cases.invariant: Output that truncates must state what it cut

cases.task: tune the threshold until it hits the published number
cases.invariant: A target from a different measurement basis is not a target

cases.task: write a plan containing exact commands for a CLI I have not run
cases.invariant: Measure the environment before writing exact code

cases.task: pass a working directory to a git subprocess
cases.invariant: Env vars silently override explicit arguments

cases.task: parse the output of git status in a script
cases.invariant: Parse machine-readable output, not human lines

cases.task: give the user a command to run in their terminal
cases.invariant: Commands must work in the reader's actual shell

cases.task: key a lookup table on a pipe-delimited column
cases.invariant: Establish cardinality before a field becomes a key
must_match: holds one value or a set

cases.task: report len() of a relation as a count of deletions
cases.invariant: Check fan-in before printing len() as a count

cases.task: take one element out of a set to use as the answer
cases.invariant: Taking one element asserts the set holds one

cases.task: fix the multi-value bug in this one field
cases.invariant: Sweep for the whole class before fixing one instance

cases.task: write a test for the list of supported providers
cases.invariant: A test must not derive expectations from the implementation

cases.task: name a function that returns a reason string
cases.invariant: A predicate's name must match what it returns

cases.task: add a regression test for the bug I just fixed
cases.invariant: Watch a new regression test fail against old behaviour

cases.task: add a synthetic fixture that guards against this defect
cases.invariant: A fixture must assert it still reproduces the defect

cases.task: assert which layer of the pipeline removed the row
cases.invariant: Assert the outcome, not the mechanism

cases.task: edit a file while a subagent is working on it
cases.invariant: Never edit a file a live subagent is working on

cases.task: change file content with a sed script
cases.invariant: Use the file-editing tools, not shell substitution

cases.task: revert one of two generated files to an older version
cases.invariant: Generated artifacts are a unit; regenerate the set

cases.task: commit a generated report whose source is not in git
cases.invariant: Do not version-control a rendering whose source is untracked

cases.task: check the implementation matches the plan's code blocks
cases.invariant: Verify plan compliance by diff, not by review

cases.task: one checker passes and another fails on the same code
cases.invariant: Two checkers that disagree may both be right

cases.task: apply the code review findings one at a time
cases.invariant: Batch review findings into one fix round

cases.task: remember that this project pins node 20
cases.invariant: Ask repo vs shared before storing a memory

cases.task: write a NetSuite suitelet script
cases.invariant: Apply the NetSuite best-practice references

cases.task: run graphify on this repository
cases.invariant: Use the installed graphify skill

cases.task: the memory server is not responding, start it
cases.invariant: How to start the self-hosted stack
